cfg.title: Chemicals lifepaths
cfg.sub: Each dot is one chemical (MeSH substance) at a half-year snapshot. Counts are small (5,583 mentions across the 233 chemicals with 5 or more papers), so most fits rest on few papers. Color by switches to wave groups and lifepath archetypes learned on the chemicals themselves: the 38 chemicals with 30 or more papers (62% of all chemical mentions) were grouped with the same k-means and DTW procedures as the symptoms/comorbidities, and the number of groups was chosen by silhouette (two wave groups, two archetypes; the table below shows how the cutoff was chosen). Chemicals below the cutoff are assigned to the nearest group by a timing model; fainter means less certain. Thinning tests on the core chemicals put this at about 77% correct at 5 papers and 89% at 30 (50% by chance), so read the small-term groups as tentative. Chemical tagging shows no dip. Mentions tagged without an identifier are left out.
